newsitem.title: FINLAND: ANALYSIS, BROKERS STILL A.BERG HALLMARK - SERGELIUS.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSIS, BROKERS STILL A.BERG HALLMARK - SERGELIUS.

text.p: Robert Sergelius, named managing director at brokers Alfred Berg Finland on Wednesday, said good analysis and top brokers would still be the house's strengths.
"Strong analysis, top brokers and high ethics will continue to be our trademark," Sergelius told Reuters by telephone.
Alfred Berg -- which has been rated as number one in equities according to market share for several years -- lost its first place to Merita in the first quarter.
"It is true that Merita was bigger -- but the start of the year was excellent for us too," Sergelius said.
"Competion has become tougher, but we will strive to be in the top group," he added.

Sergelius succeeds Peter Seligson, who resigned last week. Alfred Berg's top broker Christian Uggla also resigned last week and since then media and markets have been abuzz with various rumours about the two men's future plans.
"I am not quite sure what their plans are -- but I would be surprised if they would continue in this line of business," Sergelius said.
